__comment: ArborFirmaCraft variant of tfc_strip_logs (this whole datapack loads only when the 'afc' mod is present, see AfcDataPack). AFC woods share TFC's naming (afc:wood/log/<wood>, all four forms) and join #minecraft:logs, so the same template works with the afc:wood/log/ path filter: each AFC log -> its stripped log / wood / stripped wood. Non-existent forms are pruned by MineColonies. Catches every AFC wood (incl. rainbow_eucalyptus) via the tag scan.
